defects.claim: I didn't spend all my money on Google AdWords in 2001–2003, and it cost me hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue
defects.why: The corpus says he regrets not spending more on Google AdWords but frames it as the store should have reached $250M, not as 'hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue' lost — the specific 'hundreds of millions' framing for the regret is not stated in the corpus.
